title: Dashboard-to-Backend Integration Bugs
description: Bugs found in the dashboard frontend ↔ backend API integration layer. Covers CORS misconfiguration, WebSocket issues, React hook bugs, error handling gaps, and state management problems.
architectureNotes: The dashboard is a React/TypeScript SPA using React Query for data fetching, Zustand for state, and native WebSocket for real-time events. The backend is a Go HTTP server in core/controlplane/gateway/. CORS middleware is at gateway.go:2450-2478. WebSocket uses the gorilla/websocket library with a custom API key protocol.
epicRails: Do not break existing API contracts
Frontend fixes must work without backend changes where possible
Test CORS changes with browser preflight manually
